svg.title: MDEIS foundation architecture
svg.desc: Approver uses Open WebUI and the Portal. A gateway signs the approver token and calls the orchestrator. The orchestrator calls a pinned open-weights model through OpenRouter and tools on the MDEIS MCP server. The MCP server does every calculation and release, behind a gate, and reads and writes Postgres with pgvector. An intake worker parses uploaded documents into Postgres.
